Position Overview DC International is the parent company of two direct-to-consumer eCommerce brands, Leatherology and Coverstore. We're adding a new IT Support Associate to our IT team. You'll be the first person our employees reach when they need help: a laptop that won't connect, a new hire who needs accounts by Monday, a warehouse label printer that stopped printing, an order screen showing an error. You'll own the help desk end to end and fix most requests yourself. For problems that need a specialist, you'll get them to the right one quickly, with a clear description of what's broken and who it's affecting. Our goal is that every request gets a response from a real person within minutes, not hours, and you are how we get there. This is an entry-level role with real training behind it. A senior member of the IT team will train you on our systems, and the role has room to grow into systems administration, infrastructure, and project work. We're an AI-forward team: you'll use AI tools like Claude every day to troubleshoot, write documentation, and automate repeat work. Key Responsibilities Help desk: you own it Set up and remove accounts and access across Microsoft 365, Business Central, Shopify, Jira, and Airtable, including new-hire setup and same-day departures Manage software licenses and keep them matched to the people who actually need them Set up, troubleshoot, and track laptops, monitors, docks, printers, and warehouse handhelds and label printers Install software and help people get unstuck in everyday tools (Outlook, Teams, Excel) Keep the hardware asset inventory current and handle vendor warranty repairs Close every ticket with a short note on what was wrong and what you changed First response and triage Watch the support queue during business hours and respond to new requests quickly Fix what you can on the spot. For business-system problems (Business Central, warehouse, website), hand off to the right specialist within minutes, not after hours of digging, with the impact written down Know when a request is bigger than a quick fix, and get it to the person who sets priorities with the facts they need to decide Turn hallway questions and chat messages into tickets, so nothing depends on one person's memory or inbox Keeping things from breaking Run a maintenance calendar covering patches, firmware and handheld updates, certificate and key expirations, and conference-room and warehouse-station checks Help turn automated system alerts into tracked tickets, so they don't depend on who happened to see the email Write and maintain runbooks in Markdown, written so both teammates and our AI tools can use them, so recurring problems get solved faster each time Turn repeat fixes into reusable AI skills and automations the whole team can use Systems you'll work with: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint), Entra ID and Intune, Windows 11, Dynamics 365 Business Central, Shopify, Jira Service Management, Airtable, Cisco/Fortinet networking, and Claude (including Claude Code skills and plugins). Qualifications 1+ year in IT support or help desk, or equivalent experience (coursework, certifications, home lab, or a support role in another field) Comfortable with Windows 11, Microsoft 365, and PC hardware troubleshooting Basic networking knowledge (IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi) Clear writing: your ticket notes and runbooks are what the rest of the team relies on Comfortable using AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) as an everyday work tool, and in the habit of checking their answers rather than trusting them blindly Patient and friendly with people who are stuck and in a hurry Good at figuring out what someone actually needs, even when they can't describe the problem clearly Willing to say "I don't know yet" and find out, rather than guess Preferred Qualifications CompTIA A+, or willingness to earn it within the first six months Experience with Entra ID / Active Directory and Intune Experience with a ticketing system, ideally Jira Service Management Experience writing Markdown documentation, or building AI prompts, skills, or plugins Basic PowerShell Exposure to an ERP (Business Central or similar) or Shopify Tech support in a warehouse, retail, or distribution setting What Success Looks Like First 30 days Learn our environment alongside a senior team member: devices, accounts, network, and the main business systems Resolve routine help-desk tickets on your own First 60 days Own the help desk: accounts, devices, software, new hires, and departures Write your first runbooks from the tickets you close First 90 days Serve as first responder for the support queue during business hours Get business-system issues to the right specialist quickly, with the impact clearly written Keep the maintenance calendar running on schedule About The Company DC International is a dynamic, fast-growing eCommerce company and the parent organization of two leading direct-to-consumer brands, Leatherology and Coverstore. Leatherology is dedicated to offering a thoughtfully curated collection of premium leather goods at accessible prices. Our products are designed to be timeless, functional, and personal, and many customizable with monograms or company logos and beautifully packaged for gifting or everyday use. Coverstore is the premier online retailer of protective covers for outdoor furniture, vehicles, and indoor furnishings. Our mission is simple: to provide exceptional protection for the things people value most. By selling exclusively online, we offer one of the largest selections of sizes, materials, colors, and styles available anywhere. Across both brands, we are committed to delivering an outstanding online shopping experience through high-quality products, intuitive technology, and exceptional customer service. At DC International, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We value innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement and we're excited to grow alongside individuals who share that mindset.

review_candidates.description: Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 3 years of experience with one or more optical technologies such as client transceivers, optical metro, long-haul DWDM systems, or submarine systems. Experience in one or more programming languages such as C++, Go, or Python. Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of network security postures, vulnerability management, and authentication hardening for hardware platforms. Experience with driving multi-vendor hardware optionality and conducting co-development with external vendors. Ability to use AI coding assistants and automation tools to amplify engineering efficiency and accelerate software deployment. Experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) testing and utilizing automated lab testing frameworks (e.g., OpenConfig/Ondatra). Experience in full-stack software development (e.g., Python, Go, C++) to automate the full lifecycle of optical networks, from design to production. About The Job Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits Responsibilities Learn more about benefits at Google . Define requirements and drive the adoption of simplified, universal Layer 1 architectures to scale Google’s transport network for unprecedented AI and infrastructure demands. Drive multi-vendor hardware optionality and engage in deep co-development with external vendors across all optical layers to ensure intrinsic component robustness and mitigate single-source constraints. Develop and execute extensive New Product Introduction (NPI) test plans to ensure no systematic hardware or software quality issues are discovered in production. Leverage AI tools to amplify engineering efficiency, writing software and automating lab infrastructure (e.g., using Ondatra) to qualify and introduce new products. Ensure all new optical platforms adhere to Google's unified security posture and framework to mitigate network exposure to sophisticated threats. The successful candidate will possess strong hands-on experience using SolarWinds for enterprise network monitoring and troubleshooting and will be capable of translating monitoring data into actionable operational solutions. This role requires a solid foundation in networking technologies, incident management, and enterprise IT operations supporting Department of Defense (DoD) environments. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Network Monitoring & Operations Monitor enterprise network infrastructure utilizing SolarWinds and related enterprise monitoring tools. Identify, isolate, and troubleshoot network outages, performance degradation, latency issues, packet loss, and connectivity problems. Maintain situational awareness of network health, system availability, and operational status across supported environments. Support continuous monitoring efforts to ensure optimal network performance and availability. SolarWinds Administration & Analysis Utilize SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor (NPM) and associated modules to monitor and analyze network activity. Review and interpret SolarWinds alerts, events, logs, performance data, and historical metrics. Investigate root causes of network incidents using monitoring and diagnostic tools. Generate recommendations for issue resolution, escalation, and performance improvements. Monitor network devices and infrastructure components including routers, switches, servers, interfaces, circuits, and other connected systems. Troubleshooting & Incident Response Diagnose and resolve network performance issues affecting enterprise services. Troubleshoot: Device and interface availability issues Bandwidth utilization concerns CPU and memory utilization issues Interface and transmission errors Network performance anomalies Routing and switching problems Respond to monitoring alerts and operational incidents in accordance with established procedures. Document troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and escalation actions. Support implementation and validation of network changes and upgrades. Operational Excellence Collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to resolve service-impacting issues. Maintain accurate operational documentation and incident records. Participate in problem management and continuous service improvement initiatives. Contribute to meeting organizational service level agreements (SLAs) and operational objectives. Minimum Qualifications Education High School Diploma or equivalent required. Experience Minimum of three (3) years of experience supporting enterprise IT operations, network monitoring, network administration, or Network Operations Center (NOC) environments. Demonstrated hands-on experience using SolarWinds for enterprise monitoring and troubleshooting. Experience identifying and resolving network availability and performance issues in complex enterprise environments. Certifications CompTIA Security+ certification required. Security Clearance Active Secret Clearance required. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) or Marine Corps enterprise networks. Prior experience in a Network Operations Center (NOC) environment. Experience with SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor (NPM) and additional SolarWinds monitoring modules. Familiarity with enterprise incident management and change management processes. Experience monitoring large-scale, geographically dispersed network infrastructures. Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Advanced knowledge of SolarWinds monitoring and troubleshooting capabilities. Strong understanding of enterprise networking concepts and protocols. Working knowledge of: TCP/IP DNS DHCP VLANs Routing and Switching SNMP Ability to analyze alerts, logs, performance metrics, and operational data. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple incidents simultaneously. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced operational environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Work Environment Onsite position located in Quantico, Virginia. Required to work onsite 40 hours per week. Office and secure government facility environment. Minimal travel required. May require participation in shift coverage, after-hours support, or operational surge requirements. Success Factors Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate Proven hands-on expertise with SolarWinds monitoring and troubleshooting tools. Strong network diagnostics and root-cause analysis capabilities. Ability to rapidly identify and resolve network performance issues. Effective incident management and escalation decision-making skills. Strong understanding of enterprise network operations and monitoring best practices. Commitment to mission success and operational excellence in a secure government environment.
